discourse.title: Spiritual Basis Of Dashara Festival
discourse.excerpt: Therefore, the true meaning of the Angarpana Puja is to declare that you offer all your limbs in the service of the Lord. This means that whatever work you do should be done as an offering to God. Nowadays selfishness is rampant among devotees and they love God not for God's sake but only to get their selfish desires fulfilled. As long as selfishness prevails, the Divine cannot be understood.
discourse.theme: True surrender — offer every act to God.

reflection: What would change if your ordinary tasks were offerings instead of obligations? Swami says true surrender isn't dramatic — it is declaring that your eyes see only Him, your hands serve only Him, with no bargaining for results. Pick one ordinary chore today and do it as an offering to Swami. That quiet offering, He says, is real worship.

video.title: Don't merely seek refuge; offer yourself to God | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Mar 29, 1998

seva_nudge: Dedicate your first task of the day to Swami, then do one helpful act for someone without telling anyone.
